👉 Myth: bade channel ko hi views milte hain
👉 Fact: YouTube video dekhne walon ki dilchaspi dekhta hai
👉 Achha hook, clear topic aur dum wala video pehle 30 second mein dikhao

Pehla video bhi sabke saamne aa sakta hai, bas mehnat sahi jagah lagao.
